```{r}
set.seed(494)
library(readr)
data11tumors2 <- read_csv("~/Desktop/stat_gen_2025/data/data11tumors2.csv")

split_index <-createDataPartition(data11tumors2$Class, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
train_data <- data11tumors2[split_index, ]
test_data <- data11tumors2[-split_index, ]
```

```{r}



# Then split into training and test
set.seed(494)
set.seed(494)
library(readr)
tumors <- read_csv("~/Desktop/stat_gen_2025/data/data11tumors2.csv") 

split_index <-createDataPartition(tumors$Class, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
tumor_train <- read_csv("/Users/noahshannon/Desktop/Classes/STAT Gen/Presentation/train.csv")
test_data <- read_csv("/Users/noahshannon/Desktop/Classes/STAT Gen/Presentation/test.csv")
# How many rows total

tumor_train <- tumor_train %>%
  mutate(
    across(-Class, as.numeric),  # Make everything except Class numeric
    Class = as.factor(Class)      # Make Class a factor
  )

test_data <- test_data %>%
  mutate(
    across(-Class, as.numeric),  # Make everything except Class numeric
    Class = as.factor(Class)     # Make Class a factor
  )


# Now create folds from tumor_train (which has obs_id!)
tumor_folds <- vfold_cv(tumor_train, v = 5, strata = Class)

```

```{r}
lasso_spec <- multinom_reg(
  penalty = tune(),
  mixture = 1  # pure LASSO
) %>%
  set_engine("glmnet") %>%
  set_mode("classification")

```

```{r}
lasso_rec <- recipe(Class ~ ., data = tumor_train) %>%               # 🔥 remove 'set' column
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())


```

```{r}
lasso_wf <- workflow() %>%
  add_recipe(lasso_rec) %>%
  add_model(lasso_spec)

```

```{r}
penalty_grid <- grid_regular(
  penalty(range = c(-4, 1)),  # 10^-4 to 10^1
  levels = 10
)

```

```{r}
tune_output <- tune_grid(
  lasso_wf,
  resamples = tumor_folds,
  grid = penalty_grid,
  metrics = metric_set(accuracy, mn_log_loss),
  control = control_grid(save_pred = TRUE)
)

```

```{r}
autoplot(tune_output) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_math(10^.x)) +
  labs(
    x = "λ (Regularization Strength)",
    y = "Performance Metric",
    title = "LASSO Model Performance Across λ Values"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

```

```{r}
best_se_penalty <- select_by_one_std_err(
  tune_output,
  metric = "accuracy",
  desc(penalty)
)

```

```{r}
final_lasso_wf <- finalize_workflow(lasso_wf, best_se_penalty)

final_fit <- final_lasso_wf %>%
  fit(data = tumor_train)

```

```{r}
saveRDS(final_lasso_wf, "lasso.rds")
```

```{r}
library(broom)

# Tidy the model coefficients
final_fit %>%
  extract_fit_parsnip() %>%
  tidy() %>%
  filter(estimate == 0)

```

```{r}
# Predict on tumor_test
preds <- predict(final_fit, new_data = test_data) %>%
  bind_cols(test_data)

# View predictions
head(preds)

write_csv(preds, "../lassp_preds.csv")
```

```{r}
library(broom)

# Tidy the model coefficients
final_fit %>%
  extract_fit_parsnip() %>%
  tidy() %>%
  filter(estimate != 0)

```

```{r}
conf_mat(preds, truth = Class, estimate = .pred_class) %>%
  summary()

```

## Viz

```{r}
preds <- predict(final_fit, new_data = tumor_test) %>%
  bind_cols(tumor_test)

preds %>%
  metrics(truth = Class, estimate = .pred_class)

preds %>%
  conf_mat(truth = Class, estimate = .pred_class)

```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

preds %>%
  conf_mat(truth = Class, estimate = .pred_class) %>%
  autoplot(type = "heatmap") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "blue") +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
# Load saved models properly
knn_model <- readRDS("/Users/noahshannon/Desktop/Classes/STAT Gen/Presentation/knn_model.rds")
knn_pca_model <- readRDS("/Users/noahshannon/Desktop/Classes/STAT Gen/Presentation/knn_pca_model.rds")
svm_model <- readRDS("/Users/noahshannon/Desktop/Classes/STAT Gen/Presentation/svm_model.rds")

```

```{r}
# Assume you already loaded these models:
# knn_model
# knn_pca_model
# svm_model

library(broom)
library(dplyr)
library(yardstick)
library(ggplot2)

# First: Predict on the test set for all models
knn_preds <- predict(knn_model, new_data = tumor_test, type = "raw") %>%
  bind_cols(tumor_test)


knn_pca_preds <- predict(knn_pca_model, new_data = tumor_test) %>%
  bind_cols(tumor_test)

svm_preds <- predict(svm_model, new_data = tumor_test) %>%
  bind_cols(tumor_test)

# Now: Metrics for each model
knn_preds %>%
  metrics(truth = Class, estimate = .pred_class)

knn_pca_preds %>%
  metrics(truth = Class, estimate = .pred_class)

svm_preds %>%
  metrics(truth = Class, estimate = .pred_class)

# Now: Confusion matrix summaries for each model
knn_preds %>%
  conf_mat(truth = Class, estimate = .pred_class) %>%
  summary()

knn_pca_preds %>%
  conf_mat(truth = Class, estimate = .pred_class) %>%
  summary()

svm_preds %>%
  conf_mat(truth = Class, estimate = .pred_class) %>%
  summary()

# Now: Confusion matrix heatmaps for each model

# KNN
knn_preds %>%
  conf_mat(truth = Class, estimate = .pred_class) %>%
  autoplot(type = "heatmap") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "blue") +
  ggtitle("KNN Confusion Matrix") +
  theme_minimal()

# KNN with PCA
knn_pca_preds %>%
  conf_mat(truth = Class, estimate = .pred_class) %>%
  autoplot(type = "heatmap") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "blue") +
  ggtitle("KNN-PCA Confusion Matrix") +
  theme_minimal()

# SVM
svm_preds %>%
  conf_mat(truth = Class, estimate = .pred_class) %>%
  autoplot(type = "heatmap") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "blue") +
  ggtitle("SVM Confusion Matrix") +
  theme_minimal()

```
